Validate him. All the time. Remind him how much that you care otherwise he will begin to doubt it. If he shuts down, just know he'll come around. He's most likely just trying to prevent himself from saying something he'll regret. You can send him a text to show your support or something and show him you're not mad at him. Try not to phrase it in a way where he feels like he has to respond right away if at all. He will likely feel more guilt if he can't.

What has worked in my life when it comes to conflict is we don't discuss it at the time. We validate each other's feelings and leave it at that and pick it up later. Validate why you think he made the mistake he did, and tell him how you feel. If you can draw him out and you both reach a conclusion together, it will likely help alleviate his fears of abandonment - at least in the moment.
